patterns: APPSC asks direct single facts: India's global rank in wind (4th) and largest wind state (Gujarat; Tamil Nadu is the classic trap).
Installed-capacity figure as of a dated cut-off (e.g. 39.25 GW on 31 Mar 2021) appears in APPSC departmental papers - one number with close distractors.
Other PSCs use 'which statement is not correct' on state shares/rankings (Gujarat, TN, MP).
App adds many 2-3 statement items on policies, VGF, NIWE and 2026 figures - deeper and more current-affairs heavy than APPSC PYQs; basic rank/state items match exam well.
